description: AAAI-27's style file aaai2027.sty ('2027/10/21 AAAI 2027 Submission format'), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from AuthorKit27.zip (aaai.org/authorkit27 redirects to wp-content/uploads/2026/10/AuthorKit27.zip). letterpaper as its template sets it. Two columns, set by the style. The style stops under XeTeX by design: it calls iftex's \RequirePDFTeX (aaai2027.sty l.58-59). So the first preamble line loads iftex first and makes \RequirePDFTeX do nothing. The style then loads [T1]{fontenc} and newtxtext, which under XeTeX loads fontspec and TeX Gyre Termes X (OpenType, in the mirror's newtx), and sets \pdfpagewidth/\pdfpageheight, which XeTeX has. At \begin{document} it raises a PackageError for each of 17 packages it forbids, by design: hyperref, bbm, authblk, balance, CJK, flushend, fullpage, geometry, navigator, savetrees, setspace, stfloats, tabu, titlesec, tocbibind, ulem and wrapfig (l.433-502). With natbib loaded it sets \bibliographystyle{aaai2027} itself (l.432), so aaai2027.bst is shipped. General's lmodern and its three font lines are left out (omitPreamble): aaai2027.sty loads newtxtext (l.69). aaai2027.sty refuses hyperref, ulem and setspace with a PackageError at \begin{document} (l.434-496), a policy, not a TeX failure, and General's own preamble loads all three in every document; the last preamble line turns just those three of aaai's refusals into warnings, so the rest of each document is tested. Every other aaai refusal, and every other package's error, stays an error (batch 2 probe).
